raw: [Subtitle(text="They are all human in appearance. Aside from being far too slender, and clothed in near-rags, they are indistinguishable from the Iberians met along the way, a far cry from the monsters Old José described.", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: They are all human in appearance. Aside from being far too slender, and clothed in near-rags, they are indistinguishable from the Iberians met along the way, a far cry from the monsters Old José described.

raw: [name="Skadi"]Is this not how they speak anymore?
speaker: Skadi
content: Is this not how they speak anymore?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Still no one replies.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

raw: [Subtitle(text="Outside, she has her ways of making those who will not talk, talk. But it requires that the target comprehend her speech.", x=300, y=370, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Outside, she has her ways of making those who will not talk, talk. But it requires that the target comprehend her speech.

speaker: Skadi
content: Moreover, I'm a singer right now.

raw: [name="Skadi"]A singer doesn't do that. Mister José said so.
speaker: Skadi
content: A singer doesn't do that. Mister José said so.

speaker: Skadi
content: A... child? He's mumbling a number.
